summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various integration efforts, including enhancements to the REST specification and support for Flink SQL procedures. Additionally, proposals to revive the catalog cache policy and add constraint support are being actively considered.
highlights: Reviving the catalog cache policy proposal
Adding X-Iceberg-Client-Capabilities header to REST spec
Flink SQL procedures support for Iceberg
Dedicated sync for Iceberg constraint support
